canonical_name: Lagrange divisibility theorem for a subgroup of a finite group
literal_source_claim_zh: 有限群G的子群H的阶整除G的阶
literal_source_claim_en: The order of a subgroup H of a finite group G divides the order of G.
canonical_statement: For every finite group G and every subgroup H of G, the finite order of H divides the finite order of G.
canonical_claim: For every finite group G and every subgroup H of G, the finite order of H divides the finite order of G.
